# Assessment Overview

Supplementary assessment documents available for this report:

- [architecture-diagram](architecture-diagram.md) — Layered application architecture, technology stack, and component relationships.
- [business-workflows](business-workflows.md) — Catalog browsing and maintenance workflows, domain entities, and business rules.
- [configuration-inventory](configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, runtime/build settings, secrets approach, and framework versions.
- [data-architecture](data-architecture.md) — Database configuration, catalog entities, persistence patterns, and data classification.
- [dependency-map](dependency-map.md) — Declared dependencies, compatibility risks, and test dependencies.
